name: statcheck
description: Recomputes APA-style reported p values from test statistics and degrees of freedom.
validation_evidence: Published large-scale application and validation studies
limitations: Limited to recognized reporting formats; an inconsistency is not proof of analytical error

name: Proofig AI
description: Screens scientific figures for possible image integrity issues.
limitations: Detection accuracy and false-positive rates are not independently established in this directory

name: Imagetwin
description: Screens figures for duplicated or potentially manipulated images.
limitations: A visual match needs contextual human assessment; independent validation not established here

name: Problematic Paper Screener
description: Surfaces suspect publications using multiple automated textual and bibliographic signals.
limitations: Screening flags are leads for review and cannot establish misconduct

name: Crossmark
description: Provides publisher-deposited updates such as corrections and retractions for registered works.
validation_evidence: Crossref documents the metadata service and REST access
limitations: Coverage depends on publisher deposits and metadata completeness
curator_notes: Not an AI tool; included as supporting verification infrastructure

name: The Black Spatula Project
description: Open investigation of LLM-assisted error finding in scientific papers.
limitations: Community experiments do not establish general-purpose detection performance

name: Paper Correctness Checker
description: LLM-based reviewer for objective mistakes in formulas figures and tables.
validation_evidence: Developer-reported human review of flagged issues; external replication not established
limitations: Precision reported on selected reviewed findings is not a field-wide error rate

name: Paper Assistant Tool (PAT)
description: Decomposes manuscripts and synthesizes specialist automated reviews.
validation_evidence: Preprint reports research evaluations and conference pilots
limitations: Access depends on organizer pilot; feedback requires expert adjudication

name: SciSciGPT
description: Coordinates literature and scholarly data analysis for science-of-science research.
validation_evidence: Peer-reviewed system paper reports domain-specific evaluation
limitations: Prototype architecture does not imply autonomous assessment of research reliability

name: Paper2Agent
description: Converts papers and associated computational materials into interactive paper-specific agents.
validation_evidence: Peer-reviewed paper reports evaluation on computational biology papers
limitations: Successful conversion and tool validation do not independently validate scientific claims

name: ICML 2026 Open Reproductions
description: Community agent-assisted claim-level reproduction of ICML 2026 papers.
validation_evidence: Public challenge logbooks and reported adjudication
limitations: Participation and claim coverage vary; logbook judgments need human scrutiny

name: PaperBench
description: Scores AI agents attempting to reproduce machine learning papers.
validation_evidence: Published evaluation reports 21 percent average score for strongest tested agent
limitations: A benchmark score is not an operational reproduction guarantee

name: SPOT
description: Benchmark of published research papers with documented errors for evaluating automated verification.
validation_evidence: Preprint reports low recall and precision for tested models
limitations: Dataset composition and annotation choices affect generalization

name: papercheck
description: Structured audit harness for mathematical LaTeX manuscripts driven by a human or external agent.
validation_evidence: Repository describes implementation; independent scientific evaluation not established
limitations: Mechanical quote checking does not validate mathematical correctness
